threadTool.description: Manage Feishu thread subscriptions: while a run holds an ACTIVE subscription for a thread, that thread's further events are steered DIRECTLY to the run (no main-session turn). subscribe requires a direct-dispatch run in {queued, starting, running} and the thread handle; `h:"origin"` resolves the thread the current turn's Feishu prompt came from. Re-subscribing the same (run, thread) is idempotent (updates the scope). Subscriptions end automatically when the run settles.

action.description: list: current threads + subscriptions. subscribe: route a thread's further events to a run. unsubscribe: end one subscription.

run.description: subscribe: target direct-dispatch run — the full run id, a unique run id prefix, or the run's @label.

h.description: subscribe/unsubscribe: thread handle `fs:…` (15 chars, from a routed event's display line or `list`). subscribe alternatively accepts the literal "origin" — the thread of the Feishu prompt(s) this turn started from.

scope.description: subscribe: the run's responsibility statement (≤200 chars) — quoted in every event wrapper so the worker can judge "in scope or handback". Defaults to the run's label.

subId.description: unsubscribe: the subscription id from `list` (t1, t2, …).

threadCommand.description: Thread 订阅直通：查看/建立/解除「飞书群话题 → 直派 subagent」的事件订阅（fabric.threads）。
threadCommand.usage: 用法：/thread status · /thread drop <subId> · /thread sub <run> <h|origin> [职责说明]（h 形如 fs:xxxxxxxxxxxx）
